_comment: Egypt at the start, 1 January 1200 BC (8801 HE): the Ramesside New Kingdom under Seti II, ruling Nubia to Napata and southern Canaan while the Bronze Age world collapses around it. Dates are Holocene 'year.month.day'. color: political map colour, RGB 0-255. start_provinces: groups of provinces (areas and/or province names) the country controls at the start; control is core, absorbed (the lands of tribes that allied and were absorbed) or subjugated (nomads held down by a garrison of regiments), since the given date (none: long ago, already a core). laws: the option in force for each law of data/laws.json (the rest take their defaults). techs: technologies (data/techs.json) known at the start, besides those every settled country knows. ruler_names: the regnal names its rulers take; ruler_name_counts: how many rulers already had each, for their numbers (Ramesses III). allied_tribes: unsettled countries (tribes from data/tribes.json, by key) allied with the country at the start, and their relations with it. flags: the first flag whose condition holds is flown; the last one, without a condition, is the default.
